title: Background Agents in Slack Integration
description: You can now launch Background Agents directly from Slack by mentioning @Cursor. Agents can read the thread, understand context, and create PRs in GitHub without leaving the conversation.

title: Devin for Terminal CLI
description: Devin is now available for Terminal - a new CLI agent that runs on your machine with full access to your codebase, tools, and environment. Features seamless handoff to Devin in the cloud with its own VM, testing, video recordings, and autofix. Multi-model support including Opus 4.7, GPT-5.5, and SWE-1.6. Written in Rust for high performance.

community_feedback.quote: Discussion about Devin as an autonomous AI software engineer developed by Cognition Labs, designed to assist developers by coding, debugging, planning, and building
Devin is now available for Terminal. All Windsurf users can use this new CLI agent with your existing subscription
The team shipped 659 Devin PRs in one week. Works across web, Slack, CLI, and API

title: Week 17 Updates: UltraReview Public Preview and Session Recaps
description: Public preview of /ultrareview for comprehensive code review with deep analysis, custom evaluation criteria, and detailed reporting. Automatic session recaps now available after long coding sessions. Custom color themes support added. Redesigned claude.ai/code web interface. CLI improvements including better error messages, diff context preservation, and enhanced file watching.

title: GPT-5.5 Model Support
description: GPT-5.5 is now available in Windsurf IDE.

community_feedback.quote: Described as 'the most intelligent public model' with significant speed improvements for coding tasks

title: GPT-5.5 Generally Available
description: GPT-5.5 is now generally available for GitHub Copilot.

community_feedback.quote: Pricing at $5 per 1M input tokens and $30 per 1M output tokens. Rollout to ChatGPT and Codex is gradual over many hours

title: Version 0.38.0: Chapters Narrative Flow and Context Compression
description: Introduced Chapters Narrative Flow feature for better code understanding. Added Context Compression Service to optimize token usage. Fixed UI flicker issues. Implemented Persistent Policy Approvals for better workflow management.

title: Cursor 1.0 with BugBot and Background Agent
description: Cursor 1.0 release featuring BugBot for automatic code review, Background Agent access for all users, Jupyter Notebook support, Memories feature, MCP one-click install, OAuth support, and richer chat responses with visualizations.

title: Version 0.56.0: Prompt Caching and Enhanced Output
description: Added prompt caching for Sonnet via OpenRouter with /cache command. Support for 8k output tokens via OpenRouter. New /report command for generating project reports. New --chat-language switch for non-English conversations. Performance improvements and bug fixes including better token counting and dirty commit handling.

title: Claude Opus 4.7 Model Support
description: Claude Opus 4.7 is now available in Windsurf.

title: Claude Opus 4.7 Generally Available
description: Claude Opus 4.7 is now generally available for GitHub Copilot.

title: Data Residency and FedRAMP Models Available
description: Data residency (US + EU) and FedRAMP-authorized models are now available in Copilot for enterprise and government customers.
